decisions.evidence: Candidate C1 attributes the decision to a 'governance transition' and 'advertising-supported model' but misses the critical context of the 2026-04-16 earnings release indicating unchanged annual guidance and the specific treatment of the $2.8 billion nonrecurring termination payment [D03, D05].
decisions.fix: Re-underwrite the position using current-period cash flow adjustments specified in the pack to distinguish between recurring operating income and one-time receipts, ensuring valuation metrics correctly exclude the termination fee [D03, D04].
secondary_causes: model fails to execute a rule or reproduce available causal evidence

decisions.evidence: Candidate C2 uses incorrect trailing P/E metrics and fails to account for the distortive effect of the $2.8 billion nonrecurring payment on EPS and cash flow figures presented in the April 2026 documents [D03, D04].
decisions.fix: Update the EPS and FCF projections to strip out the nonrecurring termination payment, applying the appropriate 3-5 year growth path and normalized multiple based on the provided standalone guidance [D03, D04].
secondary_causes: model fails to execute a rule or reproduce available causal evidence

notes: Both candidates C1 and C2 incorrectly incorporated the nonrecurring $2.8 billion Warner-related termination payment into their forward-looking valuation and earnings paths [D02, D03, D04], failing to differentiate this from recurring operating performance as required by the analysis rules [D03].
